stem.text: The jellyfish, *Turritopsis dohrnii*, is described as being immortal. If *T. dohrnii* is not eaten by predators or diseased, it seems to be able to live forever. There is no way to determine the biological age of a *T. dohrnii* individual.
Which feature of the cells in *T. dohrnii* could explain these observations?

A.text: very long G phases in the cell cycle

B.text: a very short S phase in the cell cycle

C.text: an ability to restore telomeres to their original length

D.text: fewer chromosomes than other eukaryotic organisms
